label: Immanent origin roles and personal realization in one numerical act of being
term: personal interpretation of an immanent origin
definition: Profile separates roles of source, expression and inclination from the personal bearers that might subsist as those roles. Expresses and inclines are primitive directed relations on roles, anchored to one source, its inner expression and its inclination of love. SubsistsAs r p is the open interpretation that the relational position r itself subsists personally as p. Origin k p q is the further primitive that, in mode k, q is personally from p. Motive and propositional order, receiving a representation, efficient production of a substance, predication of a natural kind and temporal priority do not supply either interpretation. Each person is assigned an act-of-being token by esseOf. A divine realizer has the selected numerical token divineEsse and subsistsAs for the designated role. No injectivity law, realized position, opposition, uniqueness, modal necessity, simplicity or application to the actual world belongs to the profile itself.
note: Illustrations and limits: an expression and an inclination in one knower supply distinct roles with no further subject. A personal-origin interpretation additionally realizes the terms personally and carries their orders to real relations with opposed poles. The second test in docs/notes/immanent-origins.md shows how real opposed generation and spiration can still share a recipient. No created example purports to exhibit a subsistent divine relation. The numerical token is an interpretation condition: a map to one common kind alone would model a different reading. These roles do not change the Q11 Being quantifier (496721fc-6313-5941-81b1-78caf9658520) or the distinct-being requirement of the caused-intellect definition (80dea550-60c1-447a-83bf-d3f27ea0b2a8). The theological application and the alignment of tokens with the same God who knows and wills remain open.
